newsitem.title: USA: Navajo Ariz. 750 MW coal-fired unit down for work.
newsitem.headline: Navajo Ariz. 750 MW coal-fired unit down for work.

text.p: The 750 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Navajo power plant near Page, Ariz., was shut as expected early Saturday morning for scheduled maintenance, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Monday.
The unit is expected to be down until mid-April.
The Navajo plant is operated by Salt River Project, which also holds a 21.8 percent equity stake in the plant.
Other owners include the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation, Los Angeles Department of Water and Power, Arizona Public Service Co, Nevada Power Co and Tucson Electric Power Co.
